problems.reason: Sentence 11 claims fossils range from Early Carboniferous to Late Permian, while sentence 12 limits the range to 298.9–274.4 Ma (Asselian to Kungurian), which is only Late Carboniferous to Early Permian.

notes: - contradiction: "Fossils date from the Early Carboniferous to the Late Permian." / "The animal lived between 298.9 and 274.4 million years ago, from the Asselian to the Kungurian stages.": Sentence 11 claims fossils range from Early Carboniferous to Late Permian, while sentence 12 limits the range to 298.9–274.4 Ma (Asselian to Kungurian), which is only Late Carboniferous to Early Permian.
